question: Mission Shakti is related to:

options.text: India's first test of an anti-satellite weapon
Vocational training to the socially backward

solution:
__**Mission Shakti**__ signifies India's advancement in space defense technology.

__
 
• **Mission Shakti** was India's first test of an **anti-satellite (ASAT) weapon**.
 
• This mission was carried out by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** of India.
 
• The test successfully demonstrated India's capability to **intercept and destroy a satellite** in low Earth orbit.
 
• Mission Shakti positioned India as the **fourth country worldwide** with such an advanced space defense capability, joining the United States, Russia, and China.
 
• The operation involved launching a **missile** that struck an Indian satellite, which was a predetermined target in space.
 
• The primary objective of **Mission Shakti** was to ensure India's **security** in outer space and to safeguard its assets against potential threats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The successful test of **Mission Shakti** does not violate any **international law or treaty** regarding the use of outer space.
 
• India has always advocated for the **peaceful use of space** and has emphasized that its ASAT capabilities are purely defensive.
 
• This capability enhances India's deterrence potential in the region, securing its space assets from potential adversaries.
